MAILFROM.description: The envelope sender address for email submissions. If empty, sendmail defaults are used.

MAILTO.description: The recipient email address for the popularity contest report.

USEHTTP.description: Whether to use HTTP POST for submission. Can be 'yes' or 'no'.

SUBMITURLS.description: List of HTTP URLs to submit the popularity contest data to via POST.

USETOR.description: Whether to use Tor for submissions. Can be 'yes', 'no', or 'maybe'.

ENCRYPT.description: Whether to encrypt the submission data using GPG. Can be 'yes', 'no', or 'maybe'.

KEYRING.description: Path to the GPG keyring file used for encryption.

POPCONKEY.description: The GPG key ID or fingerprint to use for encryption.

MTAOPS.description: Additional options to pass to the MTA (sendmail).
